Interpretation 01 · Separate the metrics

First-attempt success measures initial collection reliability. Final success measures the outcome after recorded retries. They answer different operational questions.

Interpretation 02 · Prioritise by impact

Failure counts alone can mislead. Compare frequency with associated payment value before prioritising investigation or operational action.

Interpretation 03 · Check the denominator

Retry recovery is calculated only over retry attempts in this dataset. A production report should also show retry coverage among eligible failed payments.
